name: Plot Sampling
description: Turn an AOI polygon (a layer or a drawn sketch) into a grid of coded sample plots in UTM metres: rectangular or circular plots, paths between plots, nested sub-plots, standard designs (SNI 7724, Winrock, ICRAF, IHMB, CIFOR) and sample-size formulas (sampling intensity, Slovin, Cochran, CDM A/R tool).
author: Defani Arman Alfitriansyah
